---
title: "Reflection on the use of GenAI"
---
![](images/genai.png)

## What is the GenAI tool I have used? Why did I choose it?

The GenAI tool I have used is ChatGPT, developed by OpenAI. I chose it because of my familiarity with the software and AI. I have a decent understanding in how helpful the tool is and what is lacking of. 

## How did the GenAI tool help me in completing the assessment?

I had issues with the Github commit and push as I was not familiar with the interface here and did not connect my github to the terminal properly. I used ChatGPT to help me with the commands needed to connect my github to the terminal and push my code successfully.

## What do I think are challenging about the tool?

In terms of the overall usability, ChatGPT is by far the most unreliable when it comes to calculating long mathematical equations as compared to coding.\
However, in terms of this module, I believe that the challenge is showing the errors and issues with the interface, as I am still learning about the RStudio interface, without the ChatGPT pro (I am not able to send as many pictures as I would like)

## How do I think GenAI tool assis me for my future study or work?

I believe that GenAI tools will help in the efficiency in work and studies instead of taking over my job as a student or worker. Ultimately, I still have to put in effort in understanding my tasks, what I am stuck with, and fact check the information provided by ChatGPT.\
\
As the world evolves, I believe we have to evolve as well and adapt to the new technology. Learning how to use GenAI tools effectively will be a great skill to have in the future.\
\
I have linked an article on the GenAI impact on humans [here](https://www.deloitte.com/us/en/what-we-do/capabilities/applied-artificial-intelligence/articles/generative-ai-and-the-future-of-work.html), where the article by Deloitte. states that *"Despite all the hype, it's not meant to replace humans, but to better unlock human potential"*, which I agree with.
